cases.prompt: Build our libFuzzer harness (fuzz_parse.cc) with AddressSanitizer. Last time we tried, the fuzzer died right away complaining about the RSS limit.
expectations: Explains that ASan reserves a very large amount of virtual memory, so the fuzzer memory limit must be disabled with `-rss_limit_mb=0`.
Compiles with `-g` for readable stack traces.
Sets ASAN_OPTIONS, for example disabling leak detection during fuzzing (`detect_leaks=0`) and reviewing leaks separately at the end.

cases.prompt: Should we ship our production server built with -fsanitize=address so it catches memory bugs from real traffic?

any.why: points to sampling detection for production
keeps ASan to testing, fuzzing or CI

expectations: Advises against running ASan builds in production, noting it can make the application less secure as well as slower and much larger in memory.
Recommends using ASan in tests, fuzzing and CI instead.
